searchText: IS it a typo in the [EIP-7805](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7805#execution-layer) ? Should `valid` and `invalid` be swapped? It's expected to be invalid as we're checking if `T` cannot be appended at the payload at step 3. But it needs to be `INCLUSION_LIST_UNSATISFIED` according to the latest engine APIs spec. Thanks! Just opened a [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10492) cc <@725415098331430932>
